note: Approved replies. Send with /api/smartlead?action=send-draft&id=<id>. Slots carry start_time + label so times render as one-click booking links.

drafts.lead: Bikash Jha, Snow Way Logistics (India) — thinks we want logistics services
drafts.body:
Dear Bikash,

Thanks for coming back. I think there may be a small mix-up, so let me clarify.

We are not looking for logistics services. We run outbound campaigns for 3PLs and warehousing companies, so that Snow Way reaches brands needing fulfilment support and those enquiries come to you directly.

If that is useful, here are a couple of times:

• Monday, August 3 at 5:30 PM IST
• Tuesday, August 4 at 5:30 PM IST

Happy to talk on WhatsApp instead if that is easier, just send me your number.

Kristen

drafts.lead: Teguh Haryanto, Samudera (Indonesia) — asked for an ocean freight quote, thinks we are a forwarder
drafts.body:
Dear Teguh,

Thank you for the detail, though I should be upfront: we are not a freight forwarder, so I cannot quote Ningbo to Tarakan.

What we do is help forwarders like Samudera win more of that work, by putting your name in front of shippers moving that kind of cargo.

If that is of interest:

• Monday, August 3 at 8:00 PM WITA
• Tuesday, August 4 at 8:00 PM WITA

Happy to use WhatsApp instead if that suits you better, or to find an earlier hour if the evening does not work.

Carolyn

drafts.lead: Veronika Lentz, Clipper Marine Spain — CORRECTION: we wrongly said we'd transport her Bavaria SR41
drafts.body:
Hi Veronika,

I owe you a correction and an apology. My last note said I could help with the Bavaria SR41. That was wrong.

We are not a transport company. We help logistics and shipping firms find more customers, so I cannot quote or arrange the move from Fuerteventura to Mallorca.

Sorry for the mix up and for taking your time. If Clipper Marine ever wants more enquiries coming in, I am glad to explain how that side works. Otherwise please ignore this and good luck with the delivery.

Eleanor

drafts.lead: Ashish Patel, Alpha Trucking (AU) — asked to be briefed before any call, we sent one line and a calendar link
drafts.body:
Hi Ashish,

Following up with the detail you asked for, rather than another calendar link.

We run outbound email campaigns for transport and logistics operators. We build the target list around your lanes and the customer types you want, set up the sending domains, write and send the emails, and replies come straight back to your inbox. What you get is enquiries from importers and exporters who actually move freight on your routes.

If you want to see how that would look for Alpha Trucking, [here is my calendar](https://calendly.com/logan-nerdyjoe/30min). If it is not for you, no problem at all.

Carolyn

Melissa
